name: manual_35acba
claim: In an ephemeral sandboxed environment running an AI coding agent, a STABLE set of test failures unrelated to any code change (missing packages the agent cannot install -- e.g. aiohttp, redis, respx) will recur across sessions and even across separate branches/PRs worked in the same sandbox. Do not investigate or attempt to fix these on sight. Verify they are environment-only, once, by git-stashing the current changes and re-running the same failing tests against unmodified code -- if the identical failures reproduce with zero changes applied, they are environment noise, not regressions, and can be reported as "N pre-existing, confirmed unrelated" without further chase each time they reappear.

decisions.notes: The '8 pre-existing failures' signature is a recurring, verified pattern for this sandbox class.

rationale: The '8 pre-existing failures' signature is a recurring, verified pattern for this sandbox class.
